claim_policy.rule: Product-level claims require code, deterministic software evidence, lawful codec boundaries where applicable, and measured physical acceptance evidence.

primary_hardware_lane.selection_rule: Keep S6 primary until measured CPU, thermal, latency, xrun, USB, and immersive-decode evidence proves it insufficient.
